plan.notes: Reviewed xtask/src/main.rs for CLI definitions, helper utilities, and cbd subcommand handlers; captured the requested target module layout and invariants.
Drafted contract clauses for module layout, CLI surface, and validate-ready/verify exit code behavior; added acceptance tests and mapped clause ids to build/test work items.

- Scope/coverage gap: contract omits behavior/output invariants for new-task/new-epic/new-review and template generation despite scope promising no behavior/output changes.
- Enforcement mismatch: XT-INV-001 and XT-INV-003..XT-INV-006 are marked static but are structural/reviewable; tighten to statically checkable predicates or add explicit tests.
- Acceptance tests miss VFY-ERR-005 (checks failed) scenario; add to AT-VERIFY-001 or a new test.
- XT-INV-007 uses test enforcement without a concrete check; either add a proof/test or reclassify with evidence expectations.
- Inconsistency: scope mentions util/git, but XT-INV-006/output list omits it; reconcile the expected util module set.

build.description: Refactor xtask into modules: move clap CLI definitions to cli.rs, cbd dispatch/handlers to cbd/*, and shared helpers to util/* while keeping main.rs minimal.
Smoke the CLI and exit-code behavior: run help commands and validate-ready/verify scenarios per acceptance tests; record evidence.
Run `xtask cbd verify --id 0002` and update evidence.json with proof locations.
Package a review archive and request a second-pass review (e.g., GPT-5.2 Pro).
